report.explanation: Operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment causing checkout errors is unverified and contradicted by current telemetry. Traces show all checkout, order, inventory, payment, and postgres spans returning 200/ok. Metrics show order v1.0.0 serving /v1/orders 200 with zero 502s; v2.0.0 shows no traffic. Deployment record only establishes baseline v1.0.0 with no prior version, so no deployment-caused fault is established. No bounded candidate is supported; hand off for error evidence.
missing_evidence: Error/failure telemetry for checkout or order (non-2xx status, error spans, or error logs) to confirm any checkout errors exist
Logs for order service (ev-dc792a13d0a8b6ef-r0-logs_order was excluded) to characterize failures
Deployment history showing a version change preceding the incident window (only baseline v1.0.0 recorded, no previous version)
